title: Earnings Allowance in the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Tier Schedule
content:
Tier schedule of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — earnings allowance at the tier review.

The earnings allowance rests on the net amount of the plan's period close lines carrying a pay date in the last six months, the net pay the employer paid through payroll:

| Period close net amounts, last six months, in total | Highest tier allowed |
|---|---|
| 12000.00 USD or more | Paystride Access Premier Plus |
| 6000.00 to 11999.99 USD | Paystride Access Premier |
| 3000.00 to 5999.99 USD | Paystride Access Preferred |
| 1500.00 to 2999.99 USD | Paystride Access Plus |
| 500.00 to 1499.99 USD | Paystride Access Standard |
| less than 500.00 USD | Paystride Access Starter only |

A record falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than that date's.

## Hypothetical readings

- Period closes in the window of 812.35, 790.10, 805.60 and 797.40 USD total 3205.45 USD: Paystride Access Preferred.
- A total of 2999.99 USD allows Paystride Access Plus; 3000.00 USD allows Paystride Access Preferred.
- A total of 499.99 USD allows only Paystride Access Starter; 500.00 USD allows Paystride Access Standard.
